name: Max's at Red Hill Estate
address: 53 Shoreham Rd, Red Hill South VIC 3937
signature: Permanently closed February 2026 — a Red Hill institution with panoramic vineyard views that served the Peninsula for decades.
editorNote: Max's at Red Hill Estate closed in February 2026. For years it was one of the Peninsula's most reliable cellar-door lunch experiences — panoramic vineyard views over Western Port, matched to the estate's Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. The estate winery continues. The restaurant will be missed.
whyWeGo: Max's has been doing the Red Hill Estate long lunch for decades, and the view from the dining room — the slope dropping away toward Western Port with French Island in the middle distance — is still the reason most people book.
